none.title: {game} has never had a season.
none.body: Create the first one with **New season**. It opens with no maps and no baselines; both are uploaded here afterwards.

dates.note: Midnight UTC. Nothing has been played in it yet, so this changes no standing.

close.notLive: {season} is not live any more, or its close was already asked for.
close.unsent: The request could not be sent.
close.title: Closing {season} cannot be undone.
close.body: Every rating settles, every standing freezes and the {ladders} ladders become final. Queued matches are cancelled.
close.bodyInFlight: Every rating settles, every standing freezes and the {ladders} ladders become final. Queued matches are cancelled, and {versions} versions mid-trial are withdrawn.

maps.title: Maps

noneInPlay.title: No map is in play.
noneInPlay.body: Nothing is paired until one is switched on.

maps.confirm: Its queued matches are cancelled; running ones finish and count. It can be switched on again.
maps.empty: No maps yet. Drop the season’s map files below.

mapUpload.or: or pick them · .json · they land switched off
mapUpload.done: {n} added, switched off. Switch them on above to put them in play.

baselines.title: Baselines

noneInPlay.title: No baseline is in play.
noneInPlay.body: A trial is played against the baselines, so every new version waits until one is switched on.

baselines.confirm: Its queued matches are cancelled; running ones finish and count. It leaves the ladder and keeps its rating, and switching it on again puts it back.
baselines.refusedTitleNoReason: Admission refused it: no reason given
baselines.empty: No baselines yet. Upload one below: a name and its two files.

baselineUpload.uploaded: {name} is uploaded, and admission is checking it. It lands switched off.
baselineUpload.failed: {file} did not upload: {reason}. Upload it again under the same name.
baselineUpload.noHashing: This browser cannot hash files here (the page is not served over https or localhost), so upload baselines through the API.
baselineUpload.name: Name: Scout, nano-bc

season.fallback: The season could not be saved.

said.season_not_scheduled: That season has opened since this page was loaded, so its window is no longer something to move: competitors are submitting to it.
said.unknown_season: That season is not there any more.
said.name_required: A season is named when it is created.
said.season_name_unusable: That name leaves no slug: use letters or digits, and not current, live, latest or new.
said.season_slug_taken: Another season of this game already has that slug. Pick another name.
said.season_name_fixed: A season’s name and slug cannot be changed.
said.season_live: A season is still live for this game. A game has at most one season taking submissions, so this one has to be closed first.
said.no_engine: This game has no active engine digest, so there is nothing to pin the season to. The cartridge has to be registered before a season can be created.
said.inside_gap: The opening date is inside the minimum gap after the previous season closed. Move it later.
said.admin_only: This account does not administer seasons.

map.off: It is off — switch it on instead.
map.outsideLimits: {board} is outside what this game allows: {minPlayers}–{maxPlayers} seats, sides {minSide}–{maxSide}, at most {cells} cells.
map.outside: {board} is outside what this game allows.
map.idTaken: The season already has a map called {map}.{off}
map.idTakenUnnamed: The season already has a map called that.{off}
map.duplicate: The season already has this board, as {map}.{off}
map.duplicateUnnamed: The season already has this board, as another map.{off}

said.map_bad_header: Not a map file: it needs an id and whole-number players, rows and cols.
said.map_invalid: The engine refused it. `tinybrains maps check <file>` prints why.
said.engine_mismatch: This node runs a different engine from the season’s, so it cannot judge the board.
said.map_conflict: Something else got there first. Reload the list.

baseline.nameTesting: {name} is already being admitted with other files. Wait for its verdict, or use another name.
baseline.nameTestingUnnamed: That baseline is already being admitted with other files. Wait for its verdict, or use another name.
baseline.nameTaken: This season already has {name}, and its model never changes within a season. Use another name.
baseline.nameTakenUnnamed: This season already has a baseline by that name, and its model never changes within a season. Use another name.
baseline.rejected: Admission refused it ({reason}). Upload it again under the same name.
baseline.rejectedNoReason: Admission refused it (no reason). Upload it again under the same name.

said.baseline_name_unusable: That name leaves no slug: use 1 to 48 characters with letters or digits.
said.hashes_required: Both files are needed: model.onnx and manifest.json.
said.baseline_conflict: Another upload of that name got there first. Reload the list.
said.baseline_admitting: It is still being admitted; it can be switched on once admission passes it.
said.unknown_baseline: There is no such baseline in this season.
